workflow client-asked, version 3

when a Slack message is posted in acme/slack, in conversation C0123
match text exists

flow, at most 240 events an hour
  events in acme as client-asked
  step asked: raise client-asked
    fields text, author.name
    label "Tell the dashboard"
  step tell: tell me "A client asked something in acme/slack"

keep author.name, text
at most 60 an hour
